title: FFT Size MicroSim
description: Interactive demonstration showing how FFT size affects frequency resolution with radio buttons to control FFT parameters.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Signal Processing
FFT
Frequency Resolution
Signal Analysis
learningObjectives: Predict how selecting a larger FFT size with the radio buttons narrows the width of the spectral peak and improves frequency resolution
Explain the time-frequency tradeoff, in which a larger FFT size buys sharper frequency resolution at the cost of a longer analysis window
Identify the peak in the purple frequency-domain display at the same frequency set by the frequency slider, such as the 440 Hz default
Predict how a rapid change of the amplitude slider produces a transient wave packet in the green time-domain trace and spectral spreading in the frequency domain
Compare the width of the spectral peak at FFT sizes of 256, 1024, and 4096 to quantify the resolution gained at each doubling
